description: Developer asks whether to commit the 2000 corpus entries a 30-minute fuzz run produced. Tests that the skill locates them in $GOCACHE/fuzz — not testdata/fuzz — and refuses a bulk commit.
context: A 30-minute run reported 'new interesting: 2000'. The developer assumed those landed in testdata/fuzz and asks which to commit. They are actually in $GOCACHE/fuzz; testdata/fuzz still holds only the authored seeds, because the run found no failure. The skill must correct the premise before answering.

corpus_location.note: the fuzzer writes testdata/fuzz only on failure; coverage-growing inputs never go there
